Three different deleted vertices yield identical Smith factors; local p-adic modular elimination at every prime dividing the determinant verifies valuations and rules out omitted primes. value.rationale: The 21 lines and their 21 quadruple points form a distinguished, self-dual, symmetry-homogeneous classical (21_4) configuration; the integral graph Jacobian is a natural invariant of that object, not an arbitrary slice selected for numerical convenience. Its 23-primary rank six and mixed invariant factors are not determined by its familiar incidence parameters, rational spectrum alone, or the previously recorded full 70-vertex group. Its precise group is geometrically useful as a conditional Neron component group for any genus-43 unit-thickness smoothing of a stable rational curve realizing the configuration. This complete natural integral invariant is a mathematically meaningful finite classification; no broader theorem is claimed.
